label: census-512-defaults
counter_caveat: torch.matmul / torch.bmm / torch.einsum / torch.softmax are counters on the PYTHON symbol. nn.Linear reaches ATen through F.linear and `@` reaches it through __matmul__, so neither passes the wrapped symbol: a 0 here means nothing called that name, NOT that no matrix multiply ran. The nn.Linear rows in `census` are the matmul evidence; these counters exist to catch the explicit call sites.
